main_body: multi-story campus building with flat concrete rooftop
top_band: grey tiled flat roof with parapet and HVAC/skylight details from row 1 to row 38
evidence: Rows 1-38 show a clear foreshortened horizontal rooftop with concrete slab grid, inner parapet shadow (rows 4-5), an AC unit and skylight drawn in 3/4 view, and a lighter front parapet edge (rows 35-38). Below that is a green trim and eave shadow (rows 39-44), followed by the 4-story south facade (rows 45-159) with inset windows (dark top shadows inside every window frame) and a protruding entrance canopy.

style.evidence: The building features rich plaster/concrete speckle across both the roof slabs and wall facades, 5-6 distinct shading steps on the grey masonry and blue-grey windows, selective dark material outlines, and recessed window frames with reflections and sills that match the detail density of the Beodeul reference houses.
